body:

It includes the current G12 original-caller lineage, P02's two reference chains and current inert source mount, and actual source/mode/command mappings.

The source archive contains **23 files / 23,565,629 bytes**, mapping 1,311 original paths to 1,103 exact byte objects. Current selected Python/DATA/proof/inverses, all 195 ordinary base inputs, raw NEW fixture evidence and historical failures are retained. The new 2,262,016-byte XZ wrapper stores inert `.txt` objects; three separate opaque historical gzip inputs retain their exact already-public Git blobs. No nested old gzip was decoded. Absolute source locators remain unchanged DATA with a portable origin map.

**Source-only completion.** automatic-retention source contract remains open. No original/full/native/scientific execution, actual current instance, runtime caller equality, fit/funding, performance, κ or goal completion is claimed. Optimized full callers remain refusal-only. AI source acceptance is not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

```sh
python3 -B verify_archive_integrity.py
```

Observed once on the initial prepared 23-file package (before the documentation-only historical-coverage correction): `PASS_ARCHIVAL_BYTES_ONLY`, all 1,103 unique objects /86,647,104 payload bytes checked, with zero old gzip payloads decoded and no source/control execution. All current acceptance/manifest/catalog/nested direct pins and all 195 base member hashes are included exactly. Full Apache-2.0 and CPython 3.12.15 license copies match their pinned public Git blobs. After the documentation-only correction, all outer files were rehashed and the source archive/objects, proofs and three opaque blob bytes were checked unchanged; no archive rebuild, payload decode or fixture rerun occurred.

This is archive integrity, not a natural-language proof checker or executable candidate replay. **No `VERIFY.json` science hook is registered.** Current interpreter/stdlib/native/OS/currentness/admission inputs remain explicit external boundaries. Historical overwritten pin/mode observations, unresolved provenance locators, protected-runtime and private-context exclusions are recorded without substituting bytes or claiming full runtime portability. Those tests were **not rerun for publication**. They do not execute the original full caller or establish runtime equality; complete independent source reasoning supplies the source decision. Actual frozen R2–R6 NO-GO/timing records, source/map/writer failures, raw-LF failure, inverse limitations and corrected criticisms remain included at their recorded scopes. R1's negative is retained retrospectively in R2's PLAN/early source review; its exact round-close/timing record is **not bundled**. R7's global historical-preservation statement does not imply full historical coverage by this export. Old pending fields are unchanged; the later external receipt supplies the newly dated acceptance.

Canonical overlapping 94.550533479 remains separate from recorded policy 315.890533479. Neither is complete physical cost or transferable funding; all outside/source/compression/review/publication/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. Old paused timers remain inactive. Independent final export review, branch/commit publication, Chrome submission and exact-head hosted checks remain pending at this prepared-body checkpoint.
